notes.title: CTHULHU DETECTIVE Dev Log: Progress Update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,  [i]CTHULHU DETECTIVE[/i]—coming at you with a fresh progress update![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The main story and levels are pretty much wrapped up, and we’re now diving deep into the final polish, optimization, and QA phase. 🔧[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Here’s some juicy info for you—dig in:[/p][list][*][p] 4 core cases | 16+ hours of gameplay | fully immersive mystery world![/p][/*][*][p]20+ romanceable characters[/p][/*][*][p] 3 main endings + 20+ branch endings (yes, there’s New Game+ too 😉)[/p][/*][*][p]40+ achievements (where my achievement hunters at?!)[/p][/*][*][p] Upgraded in-depth deduction gameplay—bring your brain![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]But wait, there’s more! We’re also cooking up some fun little features to make your playthrough even more entertaining… maybe even a way to mess with the NPCs? 👀 We’ll share more once things are solid—no empty promises![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]As for the big question—the release date—we’ll have a clear answer very soon. Stay tuned![/p][p align="start"]Thanks so much for your ongoing support, everyone. Can’t wait to share the game with you all very soon![/p]

notes.title: Ask Us Anything: Developer Q&A
notes.notes:
[p][b]Q1: When's the launch? And how much will it cost?[/b][/p][p]We're aiming to release sometime in 2025! Exact date and price will drop soon — stay tuned for updates 😉Feel free to hop into our QQ group (1004346800) and casually (or not so casually…) bug us for news anytime. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Q2: Will all the cases be connected by one main story in the full version?[/b]
Yep! The cases will all tie together.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q3: Are there locked-room murder mysteries?[/b]
Yes, there are 🔍[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q4: Are there "time tricks" or timeline-based puzzles?[/b]
"Time tricks" can mean a few things—like playing with storytelling (flashbacks, etc.) or faking alibis through time manipulation. The full game has plenty of puzzles playing with timelines and alibis![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q5: Is there a system for sorting weird documents?[/b]
Yeah, there’s a simple filing system. All docs related to supernatural stuff will go in a separate evidence tab.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q6: Any plans for DLC later?[/b]
Currently...no.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q7: How authentic is the Lovecraftian vibe?[/b]
We’d call it "light Lovecraft"—it mixes Cthulhu mythos elements into a modern mystery style, without going full-on cosmic horror. Everything serves the story and puzzles—making them deeper and the characters more interesting, not just scary or complicated.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q8: How many cases are in the full game?[/b]
Four full cases, with at least 16 hours of gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q9: If the game sells well, any plans to turn it into a series?[/b]
Absolutely![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q10: Is it scary?[/b]
Nah, not really. The focus is on solving mysteries. The mood is suspenseful and mysterious—but no jump scares or forced horror. You can play without getting spooked 😉[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q11: Multiple endings?[/b]
Yep! 3 main endings + over 10 alternate endings.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q12: Will the full version have achievements?[/b]
Yes ^^[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Q13: How can I report bugs?[/b]
You can use the in-game feedback tool (look for “Report a Bug” in the settings menu). Or join our QQ group (1004346800) and ping us directly—some players say bothering the devs in the group works magic 😜[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Feel free to try the Demo on Steam! We’re still polishing the full game—can’t wait to share a better mystery-solving experience with you all soon![/p]

notes.title: 《Cthulhu Detective》v0.4.1 Updates Announcement
notes.notes:
We’ve also received a lot of feedback from players over the past few days, leading to this update. The main focus? Addressing one of the most-discussed topics among fans: What happens after reaching a certain level of character affinity? As one of the most player-responsive dev teams (or so we’d like to think), how could we ignore your expectations?

With this update, all major characters in the Demo now have their own affinity-based side endings (yes, covering all genders and ages). Whether you’ve already played or are new to the game, feel free to take on the challenge!

Additionally, we’ve collected numerous bug reports—special thanks to those in our community who provided detailed descriptions. Issues like ​​freezing​​ and ​​"insufficient tokens"​​ have been fixed. Just restart Steam to download the Demo update, and we’d love for you to test it out again.

​​Specific fixes and improvements include:​​

Fixed Ford’s tab freeze issue
Fixed unresponsive evidence pickup leading to crashes
Increased token count by 50% (applies to existing saves)
Optimized sound effect volume
Added a dedicated bug-reporting feature
Polished story content (yes, even typos are fixed)
Added dialogue skip functionality
The Demo will also be featured in the ​​Steam Next Fest​​, and we’ll keep gathering feedback to deliver a better experience. Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: Demo Launched Cthulhu Detective Joining 6.10 The Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the demo for Cthulhu Detective is now available to play!

Cthulhu Detective is BC Studio’s first self-developed Steam game. We are truly grateful for your support at this stage! However, our mission is far from complete. During this time, we have not been idle—while working hard to develop the full version, we’ve also been listening to your feedback and suggestions on gameplay, while optimizing and refining the demo to meet your expectations.

The Steam Next Fest is an important opportunity for us to showcase our efforts and share our vision for Mystery Detective with more players, testing how far this game can go. We will continue to strive for excellence and hope for your continued support and attention. See you at Next Fest! (Psst… a little spoiler: there will be an update during the event!)
